title: Car Maintenance Tracker
description: Track car services by mileage and date intervals: oil, filters, tires and more — with due, due-soon and overdue status at a glance.
howto: Add each service: name, last date, last mileage, and its intervals (months / miles).
Enter your car's current mileage so due-by-mileage is computed.
The list shows OK, due soon (within 30 days or 500 miles) or overdue status.
Tap 'Done' after a service to reset its last date/mileage to today.

faqs.a: A service is due when either its date interval or its mileage interval is reached — whichever comes first. Due-soon warns 30 days or 500 miles ahead.
In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool — it stays on this device.
It stamps the service as completed today at your current mileage, restarting both intervals.
